corrected_code:
@router.get("/api/v1/schemas/{tenant_schema}/invoices")
async def list_tenant_invoices(
    tenant_schema: str,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_db),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    if tenant_schema not in current_user.allowed_tenant_schemas:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Unauthorized schema translation access")
    scoped_db = db.execution_options(schema_translate_map={None: tenant_schema})
    stmt = select(TenantInvoice).order_by(TenantInvoice.created_at.desc()).limit(100)
    res = await scoped_db.execute(stmt)
    invoices = res.scalars().all()
    return [{"id": i.id, "amount": i.amount, "customer_name": i.customer_name, "status": i.status} for i in invoices]
